title: Nạp chunk đã verify vào profile qua profile-ingest
plan: build one profile-ingest child command per chunk
apply: call existing profile-ingest for each verified chunk
verify: snapshot before/after apply when ingesting chunks live

idempotency_contract.journal_key: chunk manifest path + child profile-ingest result
idempotency_contract.resume_behavior: rerun profile-ingest-chunks; chunk-verify prevents source drift and child commands are per chunk
idempotency_contract.duplicate_guard: chunk_manifest hash verification + profile folder/name + NLM title/drive_id
idempotency_contract.rollback_hint: rollback per child result; chunks are helper/profile sources, not VBQPPL canonical
